```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
```

```{python}
ames = pd.read_csv("~/Desktop/GSB 544/Notes/Data/AmesHousing.csv", sep=",")
```

```{python}
X = ames.drop(columns='SalePrice')
y=ames['SalePrice']
```

### Using only Size and number of rooms: 

```{python}
ct_twovars = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dropstuff", "passthrough", ["Lot Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"]) #"passthrough" just keeps the lot area and TotRms AbcGrd can also use StandardScalar
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("select correct vars", ct_twovars), 
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
scores1 = cross_val_score(lr_size_num_pipeline, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2')
print(scores1, scores1.mean())
```

### Using size, number of rooms, and building type 

```{python}
ct_dummify_and_select = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
  ("select columns", "passthrough", ["Lot Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"])], 
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("dummify and select", ct_dummify_and_select),
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
scores2 = cross_val_score(lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2')
print(scores2, scores2.mean())
```

### Using size and building type, and their interaction
```{python}
ct_dummy_get = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
  ("select columns", "passthrough", ["Lot Area"])], 
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
ct_int_size_bldg = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("interaction 1Fam", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["select columns__Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_1Fam"]),
    ("interaction TwnhsE", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["select columns__Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_TwnhsE"]),
    ("interaction Twnhs", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["select columns__Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_Twnhs"]), 
    ("interaction Duplex", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["select columns__Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_Duplex"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_bldg_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("dummify and select", ct_dummy_get),
    ("interaction", ct_int_size_bldg), 
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_bldg_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
scores3 = cross_val_score(lr_size_bldg_pipeline, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2')
print(scores3, scores3.mean())
```

### Using a 5-degree polynomial on size, a 5-degree polynomial on number of rooms, and also building type.
```{python}
ct_poly = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]), 
  ("polynomial size", PolynomialFeatures(5, include_bias=False), ["Gr Liv Area"]), 
  ("polynomial num rooms", PolynomialFeatures(5, include_bias=False), ["TotRms AbvGrd"]),  
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```


```{python}
lr_poly_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("poly create", ct_dummy_get),
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_poly_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
scores4 = cross_val_score(lr_poly_pipeline, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2')
print(scores4, scores4.mean())
```

### Tuning: 
```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV

ct_poly = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
    ("polynomial", PolynomialFeatures(), ["Gr Liv Area"]), 
    ("polynomial2", PolynomialFeatures(), ["TotRms AbvGrd"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
)

lr_pipeline_poly = Pipeline(
  [("preprocessing", ct_poly),
  ("linear_regression", LinearRegression())]
).set_output(transform="pandas")

degrees = {'preprocessing__polynomial__degree': np.arange(1, 10), 'preprocessing__polynomial2__degree': np.arange(1,10)}

gscv = GridSearchCV(lr_pipeline_poly, degrees, cv = 5, scoring='r2')
```

```{python}
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

gscv_fitted.cv_results_
```

```{python}
gscv_fitted.cv_results_['mean_test_score']
```
